cross_verification.note_en: Source: Palau's Bureau of Customs and Border Protection, Division of Immigration (bcbp.pw), which lists 'One recent ID photo (2"x 2") (6 months)' as a consistent requirement across several long-stay visa categories (Resident, Investor, Missionary, Student, Government Employee visas). Most short-term visitors to Palau do not need a pre-arranged visa at all - a free 30-day entry permit is issued on arrival, and travelers instead complete the online Palau Entry Form (palautravel.pw), which was not confirmed to require a photo. Background color and other photo specifics were not stated on the page and are left unverified. Size 2x2 inch matches the DB's '2 x 2 inch (51 x 51mm)', no conflict.
